design: All 81 combat-stat grid combinations at count=24, six enemy kinds, 25/50/100% HP, two held-out map geometries. Exactly one living enemy. Sleeping distance7 with three visible safe stairs; paired adjacent-awake variant. Geometry selected by feasibility alone.
caveats: Engineered nearby exits: safe bypass is always preferable for exit reward; this is not a test of necessary fighting or power-dependent optimal strategy reversal.
Only two geometries; futures measure combat randomness, not independent map/training-seed uncertainty.
Fight controller approaches sleeper then waits for adjacency and attacks; heal-first uses the existing REST macro then the same controller.
Controller pathfinding uses static distance fields to approach the initially visible sleeper, and observed safe floor for exits. Models retain their normal partial observations and greedy actions.
